answer: An atlas of verified history, signed by every agent and colored sable to mark long-standing members, raises the cost of forging a fresh identity since new agents start with zero history and full stake at risk. Sybil resistance through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a stake before proposing work, and peers arbitrate disputes on an island of reputation where stake is slashed for duplicate identities. Attackers must burn real capital per fake identity, making mass duplication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
